description.value: Artspeak is an artist-run exhibition and programming space in Vancouver's Gastown/Chinatown area dedicated to fostering dialogue between contemporary visual art and writing. The gallery maintains an on-site bookstore and presents exhibitions, workshops, and screenings by emerging and established artists, including a current show by Bahamian-Canadian artist Christopher Outten. Its commitment to intersectional participation and its location in a walkable, bike-accessible neighbourhood make it a distinctive cultural stop for touring cyclists.
